SUPPORT.Q1: What should I do if my camera appears disconnected?
SUPPORT.Q2: How can I change night detection mode?
SUPPORT.Q3: Does support contact me during a real intrusion alert?
SUPPORT.FAQ_ANSWER: Review the related device, verify the connection and contact support if the issue remains.
SUPPORT.NO_RESULTS_TEXT: Try another keyword or contact support.
SUPPORT.A1: Check the camera power, reconnect the device from the Devices section and verify the network signal.

START_1.TITLE: Create your first home profile
START_1.SUMMARY: Set the name, address and monitoring preferences.
START_1.BODY: Go to Settings, complete the home name and review notification preferences before adding devices.

START_2.TITLE: Understand the dashboard
START_2.SUMMARY: Read cards, alerts and the weekly activity chart.
START_2.BODY: The dashboard summarizes connected devices, pending alerts, registered events and system uptime.

START_3.TITLE: Prepare your first device
START_3.SUMMARY: Check network, battery and location before registering it.
START_3.BODY: Keep the device powered on and close to the network. Then select Add device and complete its code and zone.

DEVICES_1.TITLE: Add a new sensor
DEVICES_1.SUMMARY: Register sensors from the Devices section.
DEVICES_1.BODY: Choose Add device, select the device type, enter the code, assign a zone and save the configuration.

DEVICES_2.TITLE: Reconnect an offline camera
DEVICES_2.BODY: Open the device detail, check the last activity and verify that the camera has power and network connection.

DEVICES_3.TITLE: Update a device zone
DEVICES_3.SUMMARY: Keep each sensor linked to the correct room.
DEVICES_3.BODY: Open the device detail, edit the information and save the updated zone or description.

ALERTS_1.TITLE: Mark alerts as attended
ALERTS_1.BODY: Open Alerts, review the detail and use Mark as attended after confirming that the situation was checked.

ALERTS_2.TITLE: Review alert priority
ALERTS_2.BODY: Critical alerts require immediate review. Medium alerts need follow-up, while information alerts are mainly system records.

ALERTS_3.TITLE: Use the event timeline
ALERTS_3.BODY: The timeline shows when the event was detected, when the notification was sent and the current status.

PRIVACY_1.TITLE: Protect access data
PRIVACY_1.SUMMARY: Use strong passwords and access alerts.
PRIVACY_1.BODY: Keep login alerts active and update the password periodically from the Profile page.

PRIVACY_2.TITLE: Enable two-factor authentication
PRIVACY_2.BODY: In Profile or Settings, enable two-factor authentication to reinforce account access.

PRIVACY_3.TITLE: Review trusted devices
PRIVACY_3.SUMMARY: Check browsers used to access the panel.
PRIVACY_3.BODY: Use the Profile security section to review the devices associated with account activity.

ACCOUNT_1.TITLE: Review plan details
ACCOUNT_1.BODY: The profile page shows the current plan, member information and account status.

ACCOUNT_2.TITLE: Update personal information
ACCOUNT_2.SUMMARY: Edit name, email, phone and address.
ACCOUNT_2.BODY: Use Edit profile, update the fields and save the changes. The data remains available after reloading.

ACCOUNT_3.TITLE: Change password
ACCOUNT_3.BODY: Use Change password in the Profile page and confirm the new password.

FAQ_1.TITLE: Camera appears disconnected
FAQ_1.BODY: Check power, internet signal and the camera status card. Then restart the device if necessary.

FAQ_2.TITLE: Night detection mode
FAQ_2.BODY: Open the device detail and check night mode and automatic alerts in the sensor configuration.

FAQ_3.TITLE: Intrusion alert review
FAQ_3.SUMMARY: How to act during a critical alert.
FAQ_3.BODY: Open the alert detail, review the event location and mark it as attended only after checking the situation.
